meta.source: Steam 官方补丁说明 (Slay the Spire 2, appid 2868840)

list.zh: 稀有度从罕见升为稀有
技能牌 - 消耗 1 - 罕见 -「施加 1(2) 层易伤。敌方每有 1 层易伤，你获得 1 点力量。耗尽。」
list.en: Skill - Cost 1 - Uncommon - "Apply 1(2) Vulnerable. Gain 1 Strength for each Vulnerable on the enemy. Exhaust."

list.zh: 由 罕见 - 技能牌 - 消耗 2(1) -「手牌中每有 1 张攻击牌，获得 1 点能量。本回合你无法额外获得能量。」改为 罕见 - 技能牌 - 消耗 3 -「获得 15(16) 点格挡。每有 1 点力量，额外获得 5(8) 点格挡。」
list.en: from Uncommon - Skill - Cost 2(1) - "Gain 1 Energy for each Attack in your Hand. You cannot gain additional Energy this turn." → Uncommon - Skill - Cost 3 - "Gain 15(16) Block. Gains 5(8) additional Block for each Strength you have."

list.zh: 不再有「本回合你无法额外获得能量」的限制
list.en: no longer says "You cannot gain additional Energy this turn."

list.zh: 技能牌 - 消耗 2(1) - 罕见 -「手牌中每有 1 张攻击牌，获得 1 点能量。本回合你无法额外获得能量。」
list.en: Skill - Cost 2(1) - Uncommon - "Gain Energy for each Attack in your Hand. You cannot gain additional Energy this turn."

list.zh: 攻击牌 - 消耗 0 - 罕见 -「造成 5 点伤害。若本回合你损失过生命值，攻击 2(3) 次。」
list.en: Cost 0 - Attack - Uncommon - "Deal 5 damage. If you lost HP this turn, hits 2(3) times."

list.zh: 技能牌 - 消耗 1 - 稀有 -「耗尽所有手牌。每耗尽 1 张牌，随机将 1 张（升级后的）牌加入手牌。」
list.en: Skill - Cost 1 - Rare - "Exhaust your Hand. Add 1 random (Upgraded) card into your Hand for each card Exhausted."

list.zh: 技能牌 - 消耗 1 - 普通 -「获得 1(2) 颗星辰。抽 1 张牌。下一回合，抽 1 张牌。」
list.en: Skill - Cost 1 - Common - "Gain 1(2) Stars. Draw 1 card. Next turn, draw 1 card."

list.zh: 技能牌 - 消耗 1 -「抽牌堆中 1 张没有再施放效果的随机牌，获得再施放 2(3)。」
list.en: Skill - Cost 1 - "A random card in your Draw Pile without Replay gains Replay 2(3)."

list.zh: 无法再通过技能药水等效果在战斗中生成
list.en: can no longer be generated in combat by effects like Skill Potion

list.zh: 能量消耗从 2 降至 1伤害从 20(25) 提升至 20(30)
list.en: Energy cost decreased from 2 -> 1 Damage increased from 20(25) -> 20(30)

list.zh: 现在耗尽手牌中的随机 1 张牌，而非抽牌堆顶部的牌
list.en: now Exhausts a random card in your Hand instead of the top card of the Draw Pile

list.zh: 自身力量获得从 2(3) 提升至 3(4)
不再需要耗尽一张牌才能获得能量
list.en: no longer requires a card to be Exhausted to gain Energy

list.zh: 新增耗尽效果
新增耗尽效果
易伤从 2(3) 提升至 3(4)
敏捷从 2(3) 提升至 2(4)
伤害从 6(8) 提升至 7(9)
升级后的格挡获得从 +2 提升至 +3
升级后的格挡获得从 +2 提升至 +3
星辰消耗从 3 降至 2
星辰消耗从 2 提升至 3
改为技能牌，不再造成伤害；改为生成仆从打击牌，而非仆从俯冲轰炸牌
list.en: Now a Skill that no longer deals damage Now creates Minion Strike instead of Minion Dive Bomb

list.zh: 能量消耗从 2 降至 1
改为生成仆从俯冲轰炸牌，而非仆从打击牌
list.en: now creates Minion Dive Bomb cards instead of Minion Strike cards

list.zh: 基础伤害从 8(8) 提升至 8(10)成长伤害从 3(5) 提升至 4(6)
list.en: Base damage increased from 8(8) -> 8(10) Scaling damage increased from 3(5) -> 4(6)

list.zh: 能量消耗从 1 降至 0
不再在你打出君王之刃时给予格挡，而是君王之刃直接获得 10(14) 点格挡，因此格挡会显示在刃上并受敏捷、脆弱等效果影响。同时略微重做剑圣：君王之刃现在获得再施放 1（原为额外攻击 1 次），可与招架配合
list.en: instead of granting Block when you play Sovereign Blade, Sovereign Blade now gains 10(14) Block directly, so the Block shows on the Blade and is affected by powers like Dexterity and Frail Slightly reworked Sword Sage card: Sovereign Blade now gains Replay 1 (was: hits an additional time), which gives it synergy with Parry

list.zh: 旧版：招架 - 罕见 - 能力牌 - 消耗 1 -「每当你打出君王之刃，获得 10(14) 点格挡。」新版：招架 - 罕见 - 能力牌 - 消耗 1 -「君王之刃现在直接获得 10(14) 点格挡。」这意味着招架的格挡会显示在君王之刃上，并受敏捷、脆弱等效果影响。
list.en: Old: Parry - Uncommon - Power - Cost 1 - Whenever you play Sovereign Blade, gain 10(14) Block. New: Parry - Uncommon - Power - Cost 1 - Sovereign Blade now gains 10(14) Block. This means Parry's Block is displayed on the Sovereign Blade card and is now also affected by powers like Dexterity and Frail.

list.zh: 格挡从 6(9) 提升至 8(11)
伤害从 8(9) 提升至 9(10)
锻造值从 5(8) 提升至 6(9)
现在具有虚无；升级效果从 +1 张牌改为移除虚无
list.en: Is now Ethereal Upgrade changed from +1 card -> losing Ethereal

list.zh: 锻造值从 5(7) 提升至 7(9)
消耗从 6 提升至 9(7) 升级 升级不再提升伤害
list.en: Cost increased from 6 -> 9(7) Upgrade no longer increases damage

list.zh: 罕见 - 消耗 0 - 技能牌「对自己施加 3 层厄运。获得 1(2) 点能量。」改为 罕见 - 消耗 1 - 技能牌「获得 4(6) 点能量。本回合所有牌消耗 +1 点能量。」
list.en: "Uncommon - Cost 0 - Skill | Apply 3 Doom to yourself. Gain 1(2) Energy." -> "Uncommon - Cost 1 - Skill | Gain 4(6) energy. Cards cost an additional energy this turn."

list.zh: 自身厄运从 3(3) 提升至 6(3)；升级不再提升获得的能量
list.en: Self-Doom increased from 3(3) -> 6(3) Energy gain no longer increases on Upgrade

list.zh: 生命值损失从 3(4) 降至 2(3)；生成的灵魂数从 3(4) 降至 2(3)
list.en: HP loss decreased from 3(4) -> 2(3) Souls generated decreased from 3(4) -> 2(3)

list.zh: 格挡从 3(4) 提升至 4(6)
减益持续回合从 3(4) 降至 2(3)
减益持续回合从 3(4) 降至 2(3)
升级不再提升虚弱层数，改为格挡 +3（原为 +1）
list.en: upgrade no longer increases Weak, but increases Block by +3 instead of +1

list.zh: 新增耗尽效果
升级效果从格挡 8(10) 改为 8(11)，且不再升级灵魂
list.en: upgrade changed from 8(10) Block -> 8(11) Block and no longer upgrades the Soul

list.zh: 消耗从 0 提升至 1(0)；升级不再生成强化灵魂
list.en: Cost increased from 0 -> 1(0) Upgrade no longer makes a Soul+

list.zh: 「每当你生成一张状态牌，将此牌消耗降为 0 点能量，直到它被打出。」改为「每当你生成一张状态牌，将此牌消耗降低 1 点能量，直到它被打出。」
list.en: "Whenever you create a Status, reduce this card's cost to 0 Energy until played." -> "Whenever you create a Status, reduce this card's cost by 1 Energy until played."

list.zh: 减耗效果现在持续至该牌被打出，而非仅持续到本回合结束
list.en: cost reduction effect now lasts until it is played, instead of just until the end of the turn

list.zh: 伤害从 6(9) 提升至 9(12)
「本回合消耗 0 点能量」改为「本回合可免费打出」；即生成的牌若有星辰消耗，本回合该消耗也会降为 0
list.en: "It costs 0 Energy this turn." -> "It's free to play this turn." This means that, if the card it generates has a Star cost, this cost is now also reduced to 0 this turn

list.zh: 镀层从 7(9) 提升至 9(12)
升级效果从移除耗尽改为额外 +1 点能量
list.en: upgrade changed from losing Exhaust -> +1 additional Energy

list.zh: 现在可以自行选择从弃牌堆回手的 2 张（或更少）牌，不再随机选取
list.en: now lets you choose which 2 cards (or fewer) to return from your Discard Pile instead of selecting randomly

list.zh: 不再随机选取，改为允许你自行选择从弃牌堆放回手牌的 2 张牌（也可以只选 1 张或更少）
list.en: instead of selecting randomly now allows you to choose which 2 cards will be put into your Hand from your Discard Pile (you may also now choose fewer than 2 cards if you want)

list.zh: 回手的卡牌数升级后从 2 张增至 3 张
list.en: the number of cards returned to your hand now upgrades from 2 -> 3

list.zh: 消耗从 1 提升至 2
效果无法叠加
新增耗尽效果
能力牌 - 稀有 - 消耗 1「每当你打出一张无色牌，获得 1(2) 点力量。」改为「（固有。）每当你生成一张牌，获得 1 点力量。」
list.en: "Power - Rare - Cost 1 Whenever you play a Colorless Card, gain 1(2) Strength." -> "Power - Rare - Cost 1 (Innate.) Whenever you create a card, gain 1 Strength."

list.zh: 伤害从 4(5) 提升至 4(6)
下一回合的格挡从 4(6) 提升至 5(7)
锻造值从 6(10) 提升至 9(13)
升级效果从 +2 伤害改为额外攻击 1 次
list.en: Upgrade changed from +2 damage -> 1 additional hit

list.zh: 抽牌时机从本回合改为下一回合；星辰消耗从 2 降至 1
list.en: Card draw changed from this turn → next turn Star cost decreased from 2 → 1

list.zh: 改为立即抽牌，而非下一回合再抽
list.en: now draws cards immediately instead of next turn

list.zh: 不再提升君王之刃的消耗
list.en: no longer increases the cost of Sovereign Blade

list.zh: 能量消耗从 2 提升至 3
墨附魔不再提供额外伤害（仍会施加虚弱）
list.en: Inky enchantment no longer gives additional damage (still applies Weak)

list.zh: 墨附魔的伤害加成从 +2 降至 +1
墨附魔的伤害加成从 +2 降至 +1
稀有 - 消耗 1 - 技能牌「本回合每打出一张攻击牌，获得 2(3) 点力量。」改为「将 2(3) 张墨刃飞刀加入手牌。」
list.en: "Rare - Cost 1 - Skill | This turn, whenever you play an Attack, gain 2(3) Strength this turn." -> "Rare - Cost 1 - Skill - Add 2(3) Inky Shivs into your Hand."

list.zh: 飞刀数量从 1 提升至 2；伤害从 7 降至 3
list.en: Shivs increased from 1 -> 2 Damage decreased from 7 -> 3

list.zh: 伤害从 1(2) 提升至 2；升级效果从 +1 伤害改为获得固有
list.en: Damage increased from 1(2) -> 2 Upgrade changed from +1 damage -> Gains Innate

list.zh: 格挡从 5(8) 提升至 4(7)
稀有度从稀有降为罕见
稀有度从普通升为罕见
罕见 - 攻击牌 - 消耗 1「对所有敌人造成 6(8) 点伤害。若本回合你打出的上一张牌是技能牌，对所有敌人施加 1(2) 层虚弱。」改为 普通 - 攻击牌 - 消耗 1「造成 7(9) 点伤害。若手牌中还有其他 5 张及以上牌，额外攻击 1 次。」
list.en: "Uncommon - Attack - Cost 1 | Deal 6(8) damage to ALL enemies. If the last card you played this turn was a Skill, apply 1(2) Weak to ALL enemies." -> "Common - Attack - Cost 1 | Deal 7(9) damage. If you have 5 or more other cards in your Hand, hits an additional time."

list.zh: 基础伤害从 8(10) 提升至 9(11)
现在对所有敌人造成 2 点伤害，攻击 4(5) 次（原为：8(9) 点范围伤害，外加本回合每打出 1 张其他攻击牌额外 2(3) 点）
list.en: now deals 2 damage to ALL enemies 4(5) times (was: 8(9) AOE damage plus 2(3) per other Attack played this turn)

list.zh: 旧版：焚烧 - 攻击牌 - 消耗 1 - 稀有 -「对所有敌人造成 8(9) 点伤害。本回合每打出 1 张其他攻击牌，额外造成 2(3) 点伤害。」新版：焚烧 - 攻击牌 - 消耗 1 - 稀有 -「对所有敌人造成 2 点伤害，攻击 4(5) 次。」
list.en: Old: Conflagration - Attack - Cost 1 - Rare - Deal 8(9) damage to ALL enemies. Deals 2(3) additional damage for each other Attack you've played this turn. New: Conflagration - Attack - Cost 1 - Rare - Deal 2 damage to ALL enemies 4(5) times.

list.zh: 改为消耗 1 的罕见技能牌：抽 2 张牌，被耗尽时获得 2(3) 点能量（获得能量遵循再施放和复制药水等出牌复制效果）
list.en: now a 1-cost Uncommon Skill that draws 2 cards and grants 2(3) Energy when Exhausted (the Energy gain respects Replay and card-duplication effects like Duplicator potion)

list.zh: 耗尽时获得能量的效果现在遵循再施放，以及复制药水等出牌复制效果
list.en: Energy gain on Exhaust effect now respects Replay and card play duplication effects like Duplicator potion

list.zh: 旧版：战鼓 - 能力牌 - 消耗 0 - 罕见 -「抽 2(3) 张牌。每回合开始时，耗尽抽牌堆顶部的牌。」新版：战鼓 - 技能牌 - 消耗 1 - 罕见 -「抽 2 张牌。该牌被耗尽时，获得 2(3) 点能量。」
list.en: Old: Drum of Battle - Power - Cost 0 - Uncommon - Draw 2(3) cards. At the start of your turn, Exhaust the top card of your Draw Pile. New: Drum of Battle - Skill - Cost 1 - Uncommon - Draw 2 cards. When this card is Exhausted, gain 2(3) Energy.

list.zh: 若选择的牌带有异常状态，下一回合加入手牌的复制品上不再带有该异常
list.en: if you select a card with an Affliction on it, that Affliction is now removed from the copies added to your hand the following turn

list.zh: 打出该牌并选择一张带异常状态的牌时，下一回合加入手牌的复制品上不再带有该异常
list.en: if you play it and select a card with an Affliction on it, that Affliction is now removed from the copies added to your hand the following turn

list.zh: 现在在「轰击」牌之前触发（若暴政耗尽了轰击，轰击会紧接着立即打出）
list.en: now triggers before Bombardment card (so if Tyranny Exhausts Bombardment, Bombardment is played immediately after)

list.zh: 现在在「轰击」牌之前触发；这意味着若暴政耗尽了轰击，轰击会紧接着立即打出
list.en: now triggers before Bombardment card This means that if, for example, Tyranny exhausts Bombardment, Bombardment will be played immediately after

list.zh: 再施放效果现在也会在「对所有敌人造成伤害」的攻击上触发
list.en: Replay effect now triggers on "deal damage to ALL enemies" attacks too

list.zh: 再施放效果现在也会在「对所有敌人造成伤害」的攻击上触发
list.en: Replay effect now triggers on "deal damage to ALL enemies" attacks too

基础伤害从 6 提升至 8
金币获得从 30(35) 提升至 30(40)
金币获得从 30(35) 提升至 30(40)
由「对所有敌人造成 30(38) 点伤害。失去 3 点专注。」改为「对所有敌人造成 24(30) 点伤害。本回合失去 3 点专注。」
list.en: from "Deal 30(38) damage to ALL enemies. Lose 3 Focus." → "Deal 24(30) damage to ALL enemies. Lose 3 Focus this turn."

list.zh: 新增耗尽效果
现在会激发所有宝珠两次；伤害从 11(15) 降至 7(11)
list.en: now Evokes all of your Orbs twice; damage decreased from 11(15) -> 7(11)

list.zh: 现在会激发所有宝珠两次
list.en: now Evokes all of your Orbs twice

list.zh: 伤害从 6 降至 4，但闪电触发次数从 1 次提升至 2 次
list.en: damage decreased from 6 -> 4, but Lightning triggers increased from once -> twice

list.zh: 伤害从 6 降至 4，但闪电触发次数从 1 次提升至 2 次
list.en: damage decreased from 6 -> 4, but Lightning Triggers increased from once -> twice

list.zh: 伤害从 5(7) 提升至 6(8)
伤害从 5(7) 提升至 6(8)
多人模式下，现在按所有玩家打出的牌数计算伤害，而非仅统计持有者
list.en: in multiplayer, now deals damage equal to the number of cards played by ALL players, not just its owner

list.zh: 多人模式下，现在按所有玩家打出的牌数计算伤害，而非仅统计持有者打出的牌
list.en: in multiplayer, now deals damage equal to the number of cards played by ALL players, not just cards played by its owner

list.zh: 触发时机从回合开始时改为回合结束时
list.en: trigger moved from start of turn -> end of turn

list.zh: 触发时机从回合开始时改为回合结束时
list.en: trigger moved from start of turn -> end of turn

list.en: can now gain extra Block from enchantments like Nimble

list.zh: 现在可以从灵巧等附魔中获得额外格挡
list.en: can now gain extra Block from enchantments like Nimble

稀有度从罕见降为普通

锻造值从 4(6) 提升至 5(7)

list.en: Energy cost decreased from 2(1) -> 1 Now Exhausts, and loses Exhaust on upgrade

list.zh: 额外格挡从 5(7) 降至 4(6)
额外格挡从 5(7) 降至 4(6)
伤害从 5(7) 提升至 6(8)

list.en: "Every 3 times you apply Poison, deal 15 damage to ALL enemies." → "Whenever you apply Poison, deal 3(4) damage to ALL enemies."
